title: nazm.patch/1
description: A semantic patch plan, from `nazm patch rename|fix --json` and the `nazm-mcp` tool `nazm.semantic_patch`: an edit the compiler already validates — a rename (N18) or a fix a current diagnostic carries (N24) — as minimal exact-byte edits, bound to the root's semantic snapshot (N28), each edited file's digest and each edit's expected bytes. A patch is a proposal bound to exact source state, not permission to mutate files: nothing that produces one applies it. `status` is `available` with every section, or `unavailable` with a `reason` and no other section. Paths are relative to the source root and byte offsets are into the named file; nothing session-local is included, so the same sources and request give the same bytes.

reason.description: Why there is no patch. `exported`: one root compilation is not every module that may import it. `incomplete_compilation`: syntax recovery or a missing module left no snapshot to bind to — which includes every fix of a syntax diagnostic. `no_such_fix`: no current diagnostic at the position carries a fix with that index. Present only when `status` is `unavailable`.

module.description: The root module's durable key, as `nazm.snapshot/2` (`/1` before N36) gives it.

snapshot.description: BLAKE3 of the root's canonical `nazm.snapshot/2` (`/1` before N36) bytes — what `nazm snapshot --json` prints, without its newline — when the patch was planned.

files.description: Ordered by path; each file once.

validation.description: `reanalysed`: the candidate program was re-parsed and re-checked, clean, with its occurrences grouped into entities exactly as before (N18). `compiler_fix`: the edit is the compiler's own fix, governed by its applicability and precondition.

definition.description: The durable definition key, `module::kind name`; null where the module has no durable key.

member.description: A field's, a variant's or (`Variant.field`) a payload field's name; null for the definition itself.

durable.description: Whether `identity` is a durable definition key. A local's never is.

identity.description: Null for a local, which has no durable key and is not given one.

declaration.description: Where it is declared now: the source-linked identity every target has.

within.description: A local's declaring function's durable key; null otherwise.

diagnostic.description: The current diagnostic the fix belongs to, by its code and primary span.

fix.description: Which of the fixes at the requested position.

applicability.description: Exactly as the compiler attached it. A `needs_review` patch is never safe to apply without review.

precondition.description: When the edit is the right one — the compiler's, present for every fix.

description.description: For presentation only: never identity, selection or validation.

digest.description: BLAKE3 of the file's exact bytes at planning.

expected.description: The exact bytes at `start..end` the edit replaces.

edits.description: Ordered by start, then end; disjoint; no two at one point. Serialisation order, not application order.
